stops.note: the same root as "shagreen", rough untanned leather
the roughness of the leather was metaphorically extended to a feeling of irritation
French 'chagrin' also meant shagreen, rough sharkskin leather; the two words may be linked by the idea of chafing
stops.meaning: a feeling of embarrassment or annoyance

current_meaning: a feeling of distress or embarrassment caused by failure or disappointment
